description: apcore exception -> JSON-RPC error parity (Algorithm A-ERR). The runner reconstructs the apcore exception from `input`, calls ErrorMapper.to_jsonrpc_error, asserts the code, and asserts message contains/excludes substrings. A case carrying `"surface": "server"` is not reconstructible as an apcore exception and is skipped by mapper-level runners. Codes per docs/spec/srs.md FR-ERR-* and the README error-code table.

error_cases.description: ACLDeniedError -> -32040 with the fixed message "Access denied"; caller and module suppressed (NFR-SEC-001). The class of refusal is conveyed, the detail is not.

ApprovalDeniedError -> -32041 with the fixed message "Approval denied". Must NOT fall into the -32603 catch-all: "Internal server error" is the canonical retryable failure, and a human explicitly refused this call.

input.message: Approval denied by alice@example.com for approval 7f3c1e; module admin.users.delete

error_cases.description: ApprovalTimeoutError -> -32042 with the fixed message "Approval timed out". Distinct from MODULE_TIMEOUT's "Execution timeout" (an execution deadline) and from the -32603 catch-all: nobody refused, nobody answered, and a re-submission may legitimately be approved.

input.message: Approval 7f3c1e timed out after 300s waiting on alice@example.com

error_cases.description: ApprovalPendingError is NOT a governance refusal and MUST NOT be swept into the -3204x block. It stays on the catch-all for the JSON-RPC surface; the server path maps it to TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED carrying its message verbatim, which is how the caller learns the approval_id it resumes with (srs FR-EXE-002). Re-coding it would turn a resumable pause into a terminal failure.

-32001 is reserved for an unknown task id or one owned by another principal — deliberately indistinguishable from each other, and now distinguishable from an authorization refusal. This case exists so the governance remap cannot silently take -32001 with it.
ModuleExecuteError -> -32603 with the fixed message; original text never surfaced.
An unrecognized exception -> -32603 with the same fixed generic message as ModuleExecuteError, and no raw detail.

known_divergences: Message wording reconciled 2026-06-02: both ModuleExecuteError and any unrecognized exception emit the fixed string "Internal server error" (-32603). All three SDKs already produce this via their catch-all arm (no explicit MODULE_EXECUTE_ERROR branch); docs (srs FR-ERR-008, prd, tech-design) were aligned to match. "Internal error" remains only as the JSON-RPC standard NAME of code -32603, never as the emitted message.
ModuleTimeoutError maps to message "Execution timeout" (-32603) standalone, and to a FAILED task on the streaming/server path; the streaming form is covered by streaming_events.json.

Governance refusal remap (2026-08-26, srs FR-ERR-003 / FR-ERR-009 / FR-ERR-010 / FR-ERR-012): ACL_DENIED moved from -32001 "Task not found" to -32040 "Access denied"; APPROVAL_DENIED and APPROVAL_TIMEOUT left the -32603 catch-all for -32041 "Approval denied" and -32042 "Approval timed out". All three reach TASK_STATE_REJECTED rather than TASK_STATE_FAILED on the task-status surface. -32001 now means only "unknown or non-owned task id". APPROVAL_PENDING is untouched. Breaking change for clients that matched -32001 or the literal "Task not found" to detect an authorization failure.

disclose_refusal_reason (srs FR-ERR-011) defaults to false in all three bindings. Every case here pins the default; the opt-in path is covered by each binding's own message-policy test rather than by a fixture, because the forwarded text is apcore's wording and would couple the fixture to an apcore release.
